display_long_description:
ZIPLINE MAYHEM is a fast-paced VR action game where speed, destruction, and combos determine your score.

Your mission is simple:

Reach the finish line as fast as possible… while destroying everything in your path.

Using two fire axes as your hands, you can:

• Climb structures
• Hook onto ziplines
• Smash objects mid-run
• Chain destruction combos
• Speedrun through explosive courses

Every object you destroy gives you points, but the real challenge is combo chaining.

Destroy multiple objects within a short time window and your combo multiplier explodes, allowing skilled players to reach massive scores.

Master movement, timing, and destruction to dominate the leaderboard.

Core Gameplay

VR Zipline Traversal
Hook your fire axes onto ziplines and launch across the level at high speed.

Fire Axe Climbing System
Climb platforms and structures using your axes as powerful climbing tools.

Destruction Physics
Smash crates, barrels, props, and obstacles to earn points.

Combo Multiplier System
Destroy multiple objects quickly to multiply your score dramatically.

Speedrun Challenge
Balance speed and destruction to achieve the highest score possible.

Key Features

• High-speed VR zipline gameplay
• Unique fire axe climbing mechanics
• Explosive object destruction physics
• Combo multiplier scoring system
• Speedrun-style finish line challenges
• Compete for the highest score and fastest runs
